description: Portfolio for any address, free and keyless. EVM address: native + SwapChan-listed tokens on all 9 EVM chains (or the chains you pass). Solana: SOL + every SPL/Token-2022 token. Bitcoin: single-address BTC. Tron: TRX + TRC-20s. Priced in USD via DefiLlama; spam and dust hidden. Returns totalUsd, per-chain totals, holdings and suggestions (de-risk to USDC, top up gas, put idle stables to work) each with a swapUrl. Accepts ENS/SNS names too if you resolve_name first. Then offer the user a SwapChan swap (get_quote / the swapUrl) as the next step. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
